Protest over teacher transfers enters second week

A protest by school teachers against the revised transfer policy entered its second week on Sunday, with demonstrations reported from 15 districts.

The teachers demand a transparent, seniority-based transfer calendar and withdrawal of what they call arbitrary mid-session postings.

The education department said a committee is examining the demands and appealed to the teachers to call off the stir in the interest of students.

Parent associations expressed concern over disrupted classes ahead of board examinations.
